config.notes:
SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-07: FHIRPath — §5.5.4 Date Conversion, §5.5.5 DateTime Conversion, §5.5.6 Decimal Conversion. Test these items: toDate(), convertsToDate(), toDateTime(), convertsToDateTime(), toDecimal(), convertsToDecimal(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.evidence: The FP-07 SKEPTIC probe showed zero-argument conversion functions accepting invalid arguments or unsupported global argument forms. Native accepted '1'.toDecimal(2), '2015'.toDate(2), '2015'.toDateTime(2), and '1'.convertsToDecimal(2) with successful values and fhirpath_is_valid=true. Forced fallback accepted '1'.convertsToDecimal(2) and global forms such as convertsToDecimal(decimalInt), convertsToDate(validDate), and convertsToDateTime(validDateTime). The normative signatures for these functions have no parameters.
issues.root_cause: Native conversion dispatch only enforced exact arity for FP-06 Boolean/Integer converters, and the Python invocation registry still advertised one-argument forms for FP-07 convertsToX helpers.
issues.resolution: Added zero-argument arity metadata for Python fallback toDecimal/toDate/toDateTime/convertsToDecimal/convertsToDate/convertsToDateTime and native exact-arity checks for the same FP-07 functions.
issues.verified_in: FP-07 probe 59/59 with zero mismatches; test_conversion_parity.py 16 passed; native fhirpath sqllogictest 402 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.evidence: Native C++ returned decimal 2015.0 for @2015.toDecimal(), while forced Python fallback returned empty. The spec allows Decimal conversion only for Integer, Decimal, String convertible by (+|-)?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?, and Boolean inputs; Date is not allowed.
issues.root_cause: Native fn_toDecimal fell through to toString() for unsupported non-String values after handling numeric and Boolean inputs, so Date text such as @2015 matched the decimal regex.
issues.resolution: Restricted native decimal string parsing to values whose effective type is String; unsupported temporal values now return empty.
issues.verified_in: FP-07 probe 59/59 with zero mismatches; test_conversion_parity.py 16 passed; native fhirpath sqllogictest 402 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback returned empty for @2015.toDate(), @2015-02-04.toDateTime(), @2015-02-04T14.toDate(), and @2015-02-04T14.toDateTime(), while native returned the expected Date/DateTime results. The spec explicitly allows Date and DateTime items as inputs for these conversions.
issues.root_cause: Forced Python fallback toDate()/toDateTime() converted only string inputs through FP_Date/FP_DateTime constructors and did not recognize already-typed FP_Date or FP_DateTime literal objects.
issues.resolution: Added explicit FP_Date and FP_DateTime handling in fallback toDate()/toDateTime(), preserving Date precision when converting Date to DateTime and extracting Date from DateTime.
issues.verified_in: FP-07 probe 59/59 with zero mismatches; test_conversion_parity.py 16 passed; native fhirpath sqllogictest 402 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.evidence: Forced Python fallback fhirpath_is_valid('(1|2).toDecimal()') returned true even though the result wrappers returned empty. The spec says multi-item input to toDecimal() ends evaluation and signals an error to the calling environment; the native path correctly returned fhirpath_is_valid=false.
issues.root_cause: Forced Python fallback to_decimal returned empty for any non-singleton input instead of raising the singleton error required for multi-item input.
issues.resolution: Changed fallback to_decimal to return empty only for empty input and raise FHIRPathError for multi-item input, matching native row resilience and fhirpath_is_valid=false behavior.
